turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Hi, this is Elena! Thanks for calling back so fast.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Of course, Elena—thanks for requesting a demo. How are you training new SDRs today, and how long until they’re call-ready?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Right now, I run the training myself for four to six new SDRs each quarter, using live role-plays and recorded examples. It usually takes about three to four weeks before they feel call-ready, but I can’t listen to every practice call, and many are still pretty nervous when they start cold calling.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That makes sense. Where’s the biggest gap on those first live calls—discovery, objection handling, or confidence?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Mostly confidence, especially when they get an unexpected objection. They usually know the talk track, but they can freeze or rush on live calls, and I don’t have enough time to review every practice session and spot those patterns early.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Got it. How are you measuring improvement during those three to four weeks, beyond your own review?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: It’s pretty informal right now—completion of role-plays, my notes, and manager feedback once they start calling. I don’t have a consistent way to track progress or show leadership that the training is actually working, so can I see how my reps are improving over time?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Yes—managers see week-by-week progress by rep, and every score links to the exact quote behind it. We can walk through that in the demo.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Oh, interesting—that kind of visibility would be really helpful, especially for sharing results with leadership. How long does setup typically take?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Setup depends on how many scenarios you want, but the pilot is designed to get one team started quickly. Shall we schedule the demo?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Absolutely, I’d love to see it. I’m hoping to evaluate something before the end of the month—do you have Tuesday at 2 p.m. available?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Tuesday at 2 p.m. works. Which time zone should I use for the calendar invite?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Pacific time, please. Tuesday at 2 p.m. works perfectly. Great, talk soon!
